link.37214fe9f448.source: 1Confirm the model routes below. Chat and embeddings use models from build.nvidia.com by default. You can change each route's model and endpoint to suit your performance needs.

OpenShell Safety · Modern CLIs · Going Further

Shift from OpenClaw behavior to the OpenShell policy boundary that NemoClaw assembles around it, then compare Hermes Agent, Deep Agents, and other modern CLI agents.

text.04f63174b3da.source: Modern agents are everywhere, and they’re conceptually simple: a model wired to tools, memory, and a routing decision that keeps running until the task is done. This course starts by building such a system from scratch, then connects those ideas to modern frameworks used by software engineers and non‑technical users alike. You’ll go from a single API call to agent coordination, grounded retrieval, deep planning, and safe deployment using NVIDIA OpenClaw and NVIDIA NemoClaw™.
text.04f63174b3da.value: 現代代理程式無處不在，其概念並不複雜：將模型連線到工具和記憶，再透過路由決策持續執行，直至完成任務。本課程將從零開始建置這樣的系統，隨後把這些理念與軟體工程師和非技術使用者都在使用的現代框架連結起來。您將從一次 API 呼叫起步，逐步學習代理程式協作、有依據的檢索、深度規劃，以及如何使用 NVIDIA OpenClaw 和 NemoClaw™ 進行安全部署。

text.334db78ef381.source: Build a basic agent loop and identify its core components.
text.334db78ef381.value: 建置基本的代理程式迴圈，並識別其核心元件。

text.3cb8262afdee.source: Implement reliable tool use and function calling within an agent system.
text.3cb8262afdee.value: 在代理程式系統中實現可靠的工具使用和函式呼叫。

text.a368c1cc4aa1.source:
Use the modules as a guided order; each page also remains useful on its own.
      Following the full path lets each module reuse its predecessor—the browser-hosted loop
      becomes a scoped workflow, that workflow moves into a persistent agent runtime, and the
      runtime's wider reach motivates the operating-system boundary that contains it.
      Start with the task you need. Every page ends in a live artifact and keeps the
      supporting code available. You can modify the examples in the browser, self-host them,
      or give this repository to a coding agent as context for a local deployment or application.
text.a368c1cc4aa1.value: 可以按照模組順序逐步學習；每個頁面也可以獨立使用。學習完整路徑時，每個模組都能複用前一模組的成果—瀏覽器託管的迴圈會演變為範圍明確的工作流程，該工作流程隨後遷移到持久化代理程式執行階段中，而執行階段不斷擴大的權限範圍則促使您採用作業系統邊界對其進行約束。您也可以直接從所需任務開始。每個頁面最後都會提供一個可直接執行的互動頁面，相關程式碼也始終可供檢視。可以在瀏覽器中修改示例、自行託管，或將此程式碼庫作為上下文交給 coding agent，以便在本機部署或應用。
